hero.title: Game clubs in your municipality
hero.subtitle: School of Gaming runs clubs together with Finnish municipalities. Find your municipality and explore what’s on offer.
hero.howItWorks: Depending on the municipality, the club meets either online from home or in person at your child’s school. A professional Game Educator is always there to guide the activity.

search.label: Search for your municipality
search.noMatches: No municipality matches “{query}”. Check the spelling, or try a nearby one.

available.empty: Our first municipality clubs are on the way. Search for your municipality to check whether we’ve reached it yet.

waitlistNote: Spots are limited and clubs often have a waiting list. If your child stops attending, please remember to cancel the registration so the place can be offered to the next gamer.

notListed.title: Don’t see your municipality?
notListed.body: Municipality clubs are arranged together with each municipality, and we’re adding new ones all the time. If yours isn’t on board yet, tell us about it:
notListed.openClubs: We also run clubs that are open to everyone, which a gamer can join wherever they live.
